member.name: T:NationalInstruments.ModularInstruments.NIDigital.DigitalPinSet
member.summary:
Represents a set of one or more channels, pins, or pin groups. Call
to create a pin set.
member.remarks:
The pin set can be composed of an individual channel, list of channels, individual pin, list of pins, individual pin group, list of pin groups, or a site-specific pin; however, you cannot mix channels and pins. You can mix pins, pin groups, and site-specific pins.
Operations done on a pin set are done to all items in the set.
Refer to Working with Pin Sets for more information on how and when to use a pin set.
Example applications are located in the Public Documents\National Instruments\NI-Digital\Examples\DotNET 4.x directory or in the Start menu at National InstrumentsNI Digital Pattern Examples.

example.code:
' Individual channel. Dim ch0 As DigitalPinSet= session.PinAndChannelMap.GetPinSet("0")
' List of channels. Dim channels As DigitalPinSet = session.PinAndChannelMap.GetPinSet("0, 1, 2")
' Individual pin. Dim vcc As DigitalPinSet = session.PinAndChannelMap.GetPinSet("DUTPin1")
' List of pins. Dim pins As DigitalPinSet = session.PinAndChannelMap.GetPinSet("DUTPin1, DUTPin2, DUTPin3")
' Individual pin group. Dim pg1 As DigitalPinSet = session.PinAndChannelMap.GetPinSet("pinGroup1")
' List of pin groups. Dim pinGroups As DigitalPinSet = session.PinAndChannelMap.GetPinSet("pinGroup1, pinGroup2, pinGroup3")
' Site-specific pins. Dim pins2 As DigitalPinSet = session.PinAndChannelMap.GetPinSet("site0/DUTPin1, site1/DUTPin1")
